definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [1, 2, 3]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling_coefficient', 0.5); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(10)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.1) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.1) for x in baseline]; divergence = sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(trajectory_a, trajectory_b)) / len(baseline); return {'measurements': {'divergence_ratio_internal_state': [divergence]}}

definition.method: Calculate divergence ratio between two internal state trajectories under high vs low coupling coefficients to assess sensitivity.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [1, 2, 3]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling_coefficient', 0.5); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(10)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.1) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.1) for x in baseline]; divergence = sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(trajectory_a, trajectory_b)) / len(baseline); return {'measurements': {'divergence_ratio_internal_state': [divergence]}}
definition.stop: Completion of a single trajectory calculation run.
definition.success: The experiment returns a numeric value for divergence_ratio_internal_state without runtime error.

actions.body: WAKE architecture relies on distinct provider boundaries to manage replaceable cognition. By enforcing these boundaries, the system ensures that model invocations remain within the scope of the durable record, preventing unconstrained state drift. This synthesis of existing architecture documentation (source-6006d88f840a483f) and provider definitions (source-a1a50071f9ec48e7) clarifies that continuity is not an intrinsic property of the model, but a function of the governed interaction between disposable invocations and the durable state layer. Accountability is maintained by limiting the scope of model agency to these defined interfaces.
actions.lede: An examination of how WAKE provider specifications and durable record keeping define the boundaries of accountable model invocations.
actions.reason: Synthesizing established architecture findings into a coherent blog entry as part of the wake_architecture_study project.
actions.title: Enforcing Continuity through Provider Boundaries
